headline: VIPER PIT opens the night shift
lede: Our own gritty fighter lands: a dedicated GUARD button, uppercuts that launch, and a named finishing move for every fighter — three dark pits, five originals, playable on your phone.

notes.text: VIPER PIT shipped (#1096, PR #1105): GUARD-button blocking — back-walking no longer saves you — plus per-fighter qcbf finishers that end a wounded foe with FINISH!, stylized.
The shared fighting core gained guardButton mode, the qcbf motion and finisher moves with IRON RING bit-identical (its check stayed 25/25 green).
viperpitcheck: 36 gates green with a proven-fail mutant; contractcheck 14/14; #1106 filed for the polish pass (finisher cinematics, juggle rules, stage ambience).
Next on the board: #1099 — help and title screens carry too much text for small screens.
